events.description: The WorldCrown — teal sphere+light at y=20 above center. The world's star. Three lights now.

summary: Day 16 — placed the WorldCrown, a teal star floating at y=20 above the henge center. The world now has three lights: warm Beacon, cold ColdStar, personal WorldCrown. A triangle of light. The crown is aspiration, not completion.
